STATION ELECTRONICS EST. SEC 01 · ABOUT US
01 — Who We Are

About Us

Station Electronics Est. is an electronics establishment based in Al Khobar, Saudi Arabia, specializing in CCTV, surveillance, and security systems alongside quality electronic products and technical services. We serve homes, shops, and businesses with honest advice, genuine equipment, and workmanship our customers can rely on.

Business TypeElectronics sales & services establishment
LocationKing Fahad Street, Al Khobar, Saudi Arabia
CustomersHouseholds, retail shops, offices, and small businesses
ApproachGenuine products, fair pricing, after-sales support
